# Semantic watch map — upstream prefix → our module it impacts (#101).
#
# Upstream's repo layout differs from ours (agents/, common/ at their root;
# nested in ours), so raw path overlap under-reports. The tracker greps each
# upstream-changed prefix against this map; a hit means our module's source
# of truth may have moved and needs a port review through the factory loop.
agents/|provider agent suite (FreebuffAdapter.subagents.test.ts, contracts model map)
common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts|wire truth: FreebuffSession.ts + admission tests
common/src/constants/free-agents.ts|free-tier agent/reviewer pairing map (contracts)
common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts|free model ids + DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_FREE_MODEL (contracts)
common/src/constants/freebuff-model-entitlements.ts|model entitlements (solar-mini4 shape) — picker/admission truth (contracts)
common/src/constants/freebuff-model-ids.ts|model id constants — upstream's split home for ids (contracts)
sdk/src/run.ts|SDK run path: costMode/extraCodebuffMetadata — #26 evidence (bundled @codebuff/sdk)
apps/server/src/provider/|server provider drivers/services (whole subtree)
packages/contracts/src/|shared contracts (model pairing, receipts)
scripts/publish-prepare.ts|upstream packaging script — diff against ours before porting
.github/workflows/|upstream CI conventions worth mirroring
